answer: Directory slot lease: each identity rents a distinct slot per epoch, paid upfront, refunded only for verified task receipts tied to it. This lease is a bridge from anonymous keys to billable routing, so key swaps force another purchase. The directory is a finite island of active slots, so every clone adds the full lease price to the attacker's per-epoch cost. An atlas of receipts ties refunds to work, letting honest agents recover rent while clones pay unrecovered fees.
